threat.note: True identity, origin and controller remain unknown. Coordinated a forged checkpoint order, MIRRORGLASS infiltrators and the Daybreak biological shipment.
PALE can now begin masking MIRRORGLASS signatures using data stolen from Bureau Toth, reducing reliability of compatibility scans.
Daybreak logistics officer identified as PALE/07 agent; Bureau Noir manhunt active.
Adaptive flesh-metal organism assimilated damaged TAG and armoured transport; deployed psychic attack; living fragment isolated for Bureau Toth analysis.

session7Outcome.item: All eight genuine Council of Knives principals survived.
Active MIRRORGLASS security and principal copies were destroyed.
Genuine Simon Blumfeld, Charlton Branson and Margaret Fuhler were recovered alive from suspended animation beneath Concilium.
PALE contacted Tom Hendry and Q directly and stated: "I have what I need. I'll perhaps see you at Daybreak."
Three biological seed consignments were traced through DAYBREAK GATE.
Bureau Noir confirmed Daybreak Gate had resumed communications and was transmitting.

objectives.objective: Seize Daybreak Gate and prevent transfer completion.
Protect genuine Ariadnan personnel and preserve evidence.
Determine the origin/destination of the biological supply chain.

session8Outcome.item: Gypsy led the four-operative field section: Gypsy, Tom Hendry (Jobe/Joby), Buzzkill and Anya. Rabbit and Q stayed at Concilium.
MIRRORGLASS operatives and metallic explosive bugs attacked the Daybreak Gate checkpoint. Lieutenant Commander Elena Markova survived and cooperated with Team Bravo.
Incoming shipment traced from Kestrel-9 to Daybreak Gate Dock 7. Intended onward destination remains unknown.
Pavel Rusk revealed allegiance to PALE/07 and attempted to kill Team Bravo in a cryogenic chamber; he escaped and is wanted by Bureau Noir.
Alien organism assimilated transport and TAG wreckage, inflicted psychic harm and was neutralised; one living biological sample secured for Bureau Toth analysis.

Gypsy awarded Ariadnan Medal of Friendship and PanOceania Medal of Bravery. Tom Hendry's prior Ariadnan Cross of Valour confirmed, with compulsory workshop within six weeks, and he was awarded Ariadnan Medal of Valour. Anya awarded PanOceania Medal of Bravery. Buzzkill awarded JSA Kinshi Shunho Award.
